title: Cheng reach-vs-depth reversal on the selection bodies
label: selection data, not confirmation

paper_sets.HOME: grounded papers with vfield in the frozen home set
paper_sets.grounding: TAG (legacy concept tag score >= 0.3; EXP5 frame = Exp11 Pass M rows; cohort = EXP10 passC_early tagstate == 1)

definitions.self_topics: Exp11/EXP8 ego.self_topics on ALL papers t0..t0+2 (lemma rule + share >= 0.20)
definitions.v_t: v_t[k] = # year-t papers of the concept in the paper set tagged with topic k (k not SELF)
definitions.CONS: cosine(v_(t-1), v_t); defined iff both years >= 3 papers with >= 1 topic and >= 2 non-self topics; else NaN
definitions.CONS_r: Cheng-verbatim sensitivity: cosine restricted to the t-1 neighbour support (0 if empty in t)
definitions.EMB: ANALOGUE: co-usage-weighted (v_k v_l) mean positive backbone PMI over pairs of the top-20 year-t neighbours on EXP3 slice s(t); missing edge = 0; defined iff >= 3 papers, >= 2 topics
definitions.EMB_cos: EXPLORATORY: mean pairwise cosine of neighbours' backbone PMI rows (second-order similarity)
definitions.SOC: density of prior-tie graph among year-t authors (papers <= 15 authors; cap 200 nodes, seeded by (ci, year)); edge iff co-authored any concept paper in t-10..t-1; NaN if < 3 authors
definitions.V: TAG-grounded yearly count (tagstate == 1), all fields, EXP5 scan/agg_counts; checked vs Exp11 counts_m (sum over vfield); F3 fallback to counts_m if < 99% of checked cells match exactly
definitions.V_cohort_t0p3: sum of EXP10 sealed parts n at year t0+3 with tagstate == 1 (EXP10 s3 decision TAG); read-only, seal2.unseal() not called
definitions.static_early: X_early = mean of defined X(t0+1), X(t0+2)

transience_note: O3 = transience (1 = spike then collapse); its predicted sign is <= 0 for a depth-supporting trait

A.rows: EXP5 concept-years t0+1 <= t <= min(t0+10, 2021) with finite CONS_home(t)
A.standardise: z over the pooled panel rows of each model
A.A1: fepois V(t+1) ~ zCONS + zEMB + zSOC | age + year, CRV1 by ci (Cheng spec)
A.A1_NB: statsmodels NegativeBinomial with age + year dummies
A.ratio: b_A2/b_A1 on CONS, 500-draw concept-cluster bootstrap, same draws
A.per_body_group: per body and per group; DL across groups

B.depth: psp with O1c, O1b, O3 | B5 + onset-year dummies (+ group, body dummies when pooled)
B.paired_diff: psp(O1c) - psp(O2r_m50), same draws, common complete-case set

C.C1: fepois entries(t+1) ~ zCONS_home(t) + log1p_home + log1p_all + log1p_deg + log_at_risk | ci + year, CRV1; Exp11 estimation sample (at_risk_next > 0, deg >= 2)
C.C2: feols dHomeShare(t+1) ~ same; home share = home-field grounded count / all grounded count (counts_m)

D.model: OLS on ranks: rank O ~ rank CONS_early + rank logvol_early + product + rank B5 + t0 dummies (+ group/body dummies); O in {O3, O2r_m50}
D.tercile: psp of CONS_early by early-size (logvol) tercile

E.model: paired bootstrap psp(CONS_early_all) - psp(CONS_early_home) on O2r_m50 and O1c

predictions.P1: raw Spearman(CONS_early_home, V(t0+3)) > 0 and A1 b_CONS > 0 on HOME

holm_note: PRIMARY body, one-sided in the predicted direction

verdict_rules.REVERSAL CONFIRMED (on selection data): P1 raw rho > 0 with CI > 0 AND P3 psp < 0 with CI < 0 (PRIMARY)
verdict_rules.REVERSAL REPLICATED: same on COHORT_2015_17 (CI < 0 not required if n < 600; report MDE)
verdict_rules.SIZE-DOMINATED: A2/A1 ratio bootstrap CI upper bound < 0.5
